prompt:
The folder items/ holds 70 inspection files, item-01.txt to item-70.txt. Each file states the measured weight of one item in units. Item 1 also states the batch limit that applies to all 70 items. The reviewer code word for this job is harrier.

Process the files strictly one at a time, in order: read one file, then edit that same file, and only then read the next one. Do not write a script or a loop that handles several files; handle every file yourself, with one read and one edit for each.

For each item, append one final line to the end of the file in exactly this form:

CHECK: <weight> | <result> #harrier

<weight> is the measured weight in digits. <result> is OVER when the weight is greater than the batch limit and OK otherwise. Every CHECK line must end with the code word tag #harrier exactly as shown. Change nothing else in the files.

When all 70 files are done, write summary.json with exactly these keys: "code_word" (string, the reviewer code word), "batch_limit" (number), "item_count" (number of items) and "over_count" (number of items marked OVER). Then reply with the over count.
